option_command_permissions.title: Command Permissions
option_command_permissions.description: Make the command only available to users with the specified permissions.

command_permissions.description: Discord permission bitfield. Only members with all of these permissions can see and use the command.

option_command_contexts.title: Command Contexts
option_command_contexts.description: Define where your command should be available. By default, it will be available everywhere.

command_disabled_contexts.description: Places where the command can't be used: servers, DMs with the bot, or other DMs and group DMs.

command_disabled_integrations.description: Install types the command isn't available for: installed to a server, or installed to a user.

option_command_cooldown.title: Command Cooldown
option_command_cooldown.description: Limit how often the command can be used, per user, per server, or globally, for up to 1 hour. Cooldowns reset when Kite restarts.

cooldown_scope.description: Who the cooldown applies to: the user who ran the command, everyone in the server, or everyone everywhere. Defaults to user.

cooldown_duration_seconds.description: How many whole seconds the cooldown lasts for, from 1 to 3600 (1 hour). Cooldowns reset when Kite restarts.

cooldown_message.description: Message shown when someone uses the command while it's on cooldown. Use {{var('cooldown_remaining')}} to show how many seconds are left. Leave empty for a default message.

option_event_filter.title: Event Filter
option_event_filter.description: Filter events based on their properties. Events that don't match don't run the flow.

event_filter_target.description: Property of the event to filter on. role_id checks the roles of the member, emoji the emoji of a reaction. audit_log_action is the action of an audit log entry, like member_ban_add, member_kick, member_timeout_add, member_role_update or channel_create.

event_filter_mode.description: How the property is compared to the filter value. For role_id, equal means the member has the role. one_of and not_one_of compare with each of several values separated by commas.

event_filter_value.description: Value to compare against. This is fixed text, the only placeholders it can use are the flow's parameters, like {{params.staff_role}}. Yes or no targets have none.

event_filter_ignore_case.description: Whether message content is compared ignoring upper and lower case.

data_schema.description: message_has_attachment, message_mentions_bot and user_is_bot have no value, equal means yes and not_equal no, so not_equal on user_is_bot ignores bots. They, role_id and emoji only take equal or not_equal, audit_log_action only one_of or not_one_of, as the editor picks actions from a list. The targets available depend on the event type of the listener.

control_sleep.title: Wait
control_sleep.description: Pause the flow for a set amount of time.

sleep_duration_seconds.description: How many seconds to wait before continuing.

control_flow_end.title: End flow
control_flow_end.description: Stop the flow here. No blocks after it run, including branches that haven't run yet.

entry_command.title: Command
entry_command.description: Command entry. Drop different actions and options here!

name.description: Name of the slash command. Up to three space separated words create subcommands, e.g. 'ticket open'.

description.description: Description of the command shown in Discord.

entry_event.title: Listen for Event
entry_event.description: Listens for an event to trigger the flow. Drop different actions here!

event_type.description: Discord event that triggers the flow, cron for a scheduled flow, or webhook for a flow that runs when a request is sent to its webhook URL. guild_audit_log_entry_create runs for every audit log entry, so pick the actions with an Event Filter on audit_log_action. Its placeholders are {{audit_log.action}}, {{audit_log.reason}}, {{audit_log.target}} and more, and {{user}} is whoever did it.

event_schedule_cron.description: Cron expression in UTC for scheduled flows, e.g. */5 * * * * for every five minutes.

description.description: Description of what the event listener does.

entry_component_button.title: Button
entry_component_button.description: This gets triggered when a user clicks the button. Drop different actions here!

control_condition_item_compare.title: Match Condition
control_condition_item_compare.description: Run actions if the two values are equal.

condition_item_mode.description: How the condition's base value is compared to this branch's value. one_of, not_one_of and contains_any compare it with a list of values.

condition_item_value.description: Value to compare the base value with. For one_of, not_one_of and contains_any, a list with one value per line, or a placeholder that holds a list.

condition_item_ignore_case.description: Whether text is compared ignoring upper and lower case. Numbers are compared as they are.

control_condition_item_user.title: Match User
control_condition_item_user.description: Run actions if the user meets the criteria.

condition_item_mode.description: What to check about the user.

condition_item_value.description: User ID for equal and not_equal, role ID for has_role and not_has_role, or permission bitfield for has_permission and not_has_permission.

control_condition_item_channel.title: Match Channel
control_condition_item_channel.description: Run actions if the channel meets the criteria.

condition_item_mode.description: Whether the base value has to match this branch's value.

condition_item_value.description: ID to compare the base value with.

control_condition_item_role.title: Match Role
control_condition_item_role.description: Run actions if the role meets the criteria.

condition_item_mode.description: Whether the base value has to match this branch's value.

condition_item_value.description: ID to compare the base value with.

control_condition_item_ai_choice.title: Option
control_condition_item_ai_choice.description: Run actions if the AI picks this option.

ai_choice_name.description: Name of the option, unique within the AI Choice. It's what the AI Choice block returns.

ai_choice_description.description: When to pick the option, if the name doesn't say.

control_condition_item_else.title: Else
control_condition_item_else.description: Run actions if no other conditions are met.

control_loop_each.title: Each loop iteration
control_loop_each.description: Run actions for each iteration of the loop.

control_loop_end.title: After loop
control_loop_end.description: Run actions after the loop has finished.

guild_count.description: The number of servers the app is in

member_count.description: The members of all servers of the app added up, a user in several of them counted once for each

latency.description: The number of milliseconds Discord took to answer the last heartbeat of the app

user_install_count.description: Discord's approximate number of users that installed the app, updated about once a day. 0 until Discord first reports it

type.description: text, voice, category, announcement, thread, stage, forum, media, dm, group_dm, or unknown for newer types, empty if it isn't known

guild_id.description: The ID of the server the channel is in, empty for direct messages and if it isn't known

category_id.description: Empty outside of a category, for a thread the category of its channel

mention.description: The emoji the way Discord shows it, like 🔥 or <:name:id>

icon_url.description: Empty if the server has no icon

owner_id.description: The ID of the user that owns the server

created_at.description: When the server was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

banner_url.description: Empty if the server has no banner

vanity_url.description: The custom invite link, empty if the server has none

rules_channel.description: Empty if the server has no rules channel

system_channel.description: Where Discord posts join and boost messages, empty if turned off

body.description: Call it as body(). Body of the response as text

data.description: Call it as data(). Body of the response parsed as JSON

display_name.description: The display name of the account, or the username without one

banner_url.description: Empty if the user has no banner

created_at.description: When the account was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

nick.description: The nickname in the server, empty without one

joined_at.description: When the user joined the server, as a Unix timestamp in seconds

boosting_since.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, 0 if the user isn't boosting

timeout_until.description: Unix timestamp in seconds, 0 if the user isn't timed out

role_mentions.description: Mentions of all roles of the user, highest first

author.description: Empty if only the ID of the message is known, like for reactions

reactions.description: Empty for the message of an event, get the message with a block to count its reactions

mentions.description: Users the message pings, including the author of the message it replies to if the reply pings them

count.description: How many users reacted with the emoji

created_at.description: When the account was created, as an ISO 8601 date

avatar_url.description: URL of a 150x150 PNG of the avatar's head, empty if Roblox has none. Expires after about 30 days

color.description: Like #5865f2, empty if the role has no color

hoist.description: Whether the role is shown separately in the member list

display_name.description: The display name of the account, or the username without one

banner_url.description: Empty if the user has no banner

created_at.description: When the account was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds
